splitmix64.note: outputs as 16 lowercase hex digits (64-bit values do not fit a JSON number exactly)

design_effect_wilson.note: no variation: the design effect is 1

compare_many_holm.note: paired tables against the shared baseline (both, candidate only, baseline only, neither): a (23, 11, 3, 0), b (23, 9, 3, 2), c (23, 1, 3, 10); b and c take their outcomes from the tables (26, 6, 5, 0) and (20, 4, 9, 4), sample by sample

detectable_paired_range.rule: each value is the larger of the smallest increase and the smallest decrease

display_rounding.rule: percent = value * 100 on the shortest decimal spelling of the double, rounded half away from zero

display_never_pinned.rule: a value strictly between 0 and 1 never shows as 100 or 0: decimals are added for all three values up to 3, then a still-pinned value is rounded toward the inside

review_rulings.note: B1: every value equal, decided exactly; B2: one cluster holding every sample is one independent unit; S2: no bootstrap over fewer than two clusters; S3: null where no change is detectable; R2-N2: every interval holds its point (one-sided beta posterior when every trial passed or failed, else moved at its level)
